title: Called as a Boy
backstory: The little kingdom of Judah is drifting far from God, and hard days are coming. In the town of Anathoth lives a priest's son named Jeremiah — still young, quiet, and unsure of himself. God is about to give him a lifelong task: carrying heaven's words to a people who mostly will not want to hear them.

passages.synopsis: Jeremiah was a priest's son from the town of Anathoth, and God's word came to him in the days of King Josiah. God told him something amazing: before Jeremiah was even born, God knew him and set him apart to be a prophet to the nations. Jeremiah protested that he could not speak because he was only a child. God answered, 'Say not, I am a child,' then touched his mouth and put his own words there.

God showed young Jeremiah two pictures. First he saw a rod of an almond tree, a sign that God was watching over his word to make it happen. Then he saw a boiling pot tipping from the north. It meant trouble would come upon Judah from the kingdoms of the north, because the people had turned to other gods.

God told Jeremiah to stand up and speak everything he commanded, without fearing anyone's face. He promised to make him like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and walls of brass. People would fight against him, God said, but they would not win. 'For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.'

scrambleVerses.text: I cannot speak: for I am a child.
Be not afraid of their faces:
for I will hasten my word to perform it.

triviaQuestions.question: What did God say he did before Jeremiah was born?
options: He knew him and set him apart as a prophet
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:5 — "Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations."

triviaQuestions.question: Why did Jeremiah think he could not speak for God?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:6 — "Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child."

triviaQuestions.question: What did Jeremiah see in his first vision?
options: A rod of an almond tree
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:11 — "Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree."

triviaQuestions.question: What did God promise Jeremiah when he was afraid?
options: To be with him and deliver him
triviaQuestions.explanation: Jeremiah 1:8 — "Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD."

reflection: God told young Jeremiah, 'Be not afraid... for I am with thee.' When have you felt too small for something God wanted you to do?
